epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to first usable request in local environment from hours to < 5 minutes
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack startup
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml file, so that the product can be verified for real-world behavior and observability.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When I ping the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time from manual steps to < 2 minutes

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce stale materials in the knowledge base by 50%
requirements: R1: Wire UI actions to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Wire UI actions to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Wire update and delete UI for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing UI actions for this epic, I want to wire the edit and delete actions, so that the epidemiology knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user chooses to edit it and saves changes, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint and updates the catalog.
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user chooses to delete it, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and removes it from the catalog.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material update and delete operation time to < 3 clicks

epics.title: System Authentication and Security
epics.jtbd: When accessing the platform, I want a secure login flow, so that sensitive medical records remain private.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the rate of unprotected endpoint hits from baseline to 0%
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation by prompting the user to log in.

slices.title: Implement basic authentication blocking
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication on restricted routes, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material, Then the system returns an unauthorized error and prompts them to log in.
Given an authenticated user, When they access the same routes, Then the access is granted.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of restricted endpoints require active session tokens
